answer: Locks are entered in opal, expire in jade, and vault lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 26 aliases as a result needs 69 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1009 identities would post 4422 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
